nodes.description: checkBots modifier of BotProtected; performs a low-level call to protectionFromBots before the modified function body runs
owner address of BotProtected/PBXToken, set from tx.origin in the PBXToken constructor
protectionFromBots address of an externally controlled bot-protection contract
uniPair address computed with pairForUniswap and passed into the bot check
transferFrom of PBXToken; guarded by checkBots and mutates balanceOf/allowance after an external callback
msg.sender; caller controlled source of allowance and owner checks
tx.origin; used to set owner and initial allowances in the constructor
block.timestamp; used to build the liquidity deadline
low-level protectionFromBots.call(0x15274141,...) performed inside the checkBots modifier
arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) executed in the delegate function
delegate(address,bytes) payable; only owner may execute an arbitrary delegatecall
distribute(address[],uint); owner-only mass balance overwrite with an untrusted external call
list(uint,address[],uint[]) payable; owner-only liquidity provisioning and mass balance overwrite
transfer(address,uint) payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...)
approve(address,uint) payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
balanceOf mapping of PBXToken
allowance mapping of PBXToken
totalSupply constant initialized to 500000000000000000000000000
IUniswapV2Router02 instance used for addLiquidityETH
wETH address used to derive the uniswap pair
pairForUniswap(address,address) internal pure; computes a pair address from keccak256
PBXToken constructor; sets owner = tx.origin, derives uniPair and grants infinite allowances
BotProtected constructor; stores the externally supplied bot protection address
routerForPancake.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...) external call with a timestamp deadline

protectionFromBots.call(0xd5eaf4c3,_tos) untrusted low-level call inside list
